description:
Parent: fz-kdt

merge_call_emission (jobs/semantic.rs:1065-ish) extends .activations with no
dedup; emitted_activations guards only the Activation FactKey push while
activation_input_contributions.push runs per duplicate -- so
normalize_contributions re-addresses and push_rows an IDENTICAL row many
times in one conclusion. Measured at 84ae179b4 (fz2 interp debug): max
identical (key,inputs) rows per conclusion 26/3/12
(take_drop/range_map/predicate); conclusions emitting >=2 duplicates
200/13/141. Wasted work + needless ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET pressure.

Standalone fix: dedup at merge_call_emission or at the contribution push.
Cheap and safe. (Two earlier plans subsumed this -- the refuted channel deletion and the
refuted cell model; the channel lives, so this is standalone. Just fix it.)
title: One callsite emits the same callee contribution up to 35x per conclusion
